title: O gente brunette (T. Champion)
desc: Thomas Champion, O gente brunette, 1548. 4 voices (Superius, Contratenor, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Model_0002); edited by David Fiala, Marco Gurrieri, Vincent Besson, Richard Freedman. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.

poly.lyr: O gen- te bru- net- te que Dieu . gard, Se- ras- tu, se- ras- tu, se- ras- tu . . point m’a- my- . et- . te? Sou- vent je sou- hai- te ton re- . gard À mon aise, à mon aise, à mon aise . . en ma cham- . bret- . te.
